purpose: Stage 1 GPU text-only training on a Colab T4. Produces probability artifacts for local evaluation only.

A_leaderboard.status: Submission 3 preserved and protected; NOT retrained, NOT modified
A_leaderboard.future_ensemble: Submission 3 sources + new text XLM-R + BanglaBERT + optional MuRIL
A_leaderboard.note: Do not run the hybrid ensemble until new GPU artifacts exist.

B_judge_friendly_text_only.status: initial baseline built on fold set B

recommended_run_order.pinned: load pinned to the recorded Hub commit

recipe_fixed_in_advance.epoch_selection: mean of last 2 epochs, no best-epoch picking

recommended_run_order.routing: script-routed honest blend; each route weight chosen on the other folds
recommended_run_order.precondition: run xlmr_text first and pass its adoption gate

recommended_run_order.run_only_if: runs 1 and 2 leave Latin-script class 1 as the main error

models_skipped: XLM-R large (3x time per fold, fp16 instability on T4)
mDeBERTa-v3 (known fp16 overflow; T4 has no bf16)
loss-function sweeps and second seeds (selection bias)
LLM zero-shot / API labelling (external model, judging risk)
any new ID or SID variant

adoption_gates.new_source: contribution >= +0.0015, OR class-2 F1 >= +0.010 without pooled regression, OR better worst fold with fold_std rise <= 25 percent
adoption_gates.nested_offsets: strictly nested, gain >= +0.001, >= 4 folds not regressed, no class drop > 0.02, std <= 1.5x baseline
adoption_gates.package: test class share within 6 pp of train share
adoption_gates.always: one fold set only; no same-OOF and no leaderboard tuning

per_fold: runs/{name}_fold{0-4}.npz with keys va, vp, tp, te_rows, vp_last, tp_last, hist, config, config_hash
final: runs/{name}_final.npz with keys oof, test, fold_ids, coverage_train, coverage_test, meta
